loadModel.x-tooltip: How the load varies across the sweep. Blank holds Z_L constant at its f0 value. Series RC or series RL fits a resistor and a capacitor or inductor to Z_L at f0, which needs a negative or a positive load reactance. File reads the load from the uploaded load file at every frequency.

designFreq.x-derived: (freqStart + freqStop) / 2, the centre of the band
designFreq.x-tooltip: f0: the frequency the network is synthesised at, the load model is fitted at and the uploads are read at. Must lie in the band. Blank means the centre of the band.

maxQ.x-tooltip: Upper bound on each section's loaded Q; omit for unconstrained. Ladder networks are measured against the ceiling but not constrained by it.

componentSeries.x-tooltip: Standard values every element is snapped to before the headline return loss is computed. E24 is what the tool has always used.

branchPreference.x-tooltip: Low-pass (series inductors, shunt capacitors: a DC path to the load) or high-pass takes that branch of each section where one exists, and the result says when none does. Blank keeps the branch with the better return loss across the band with the chosen parts; with a part model, a branch whose parts are all within the catalogue range is taken when it meets the target.

partModel.x-tooltip: Generic models each element as a real chip part of the chosen package: capacitors as C0G with series resistance and inductance, inductors with series resistance and the parallel capacitance that sets their self-resonance. Blank or ideal computes perfect L and C, as the tool always has.

packageSize.x-tooltip: EIA size of every modelled part. Read only with generic parts.

inductorTechnology.x-tooltip: Wirewound (ceramic core: higher Q) or multilayer chip inductors. Read only with generic parts.

capTolerance.x-tooltip: Purchase tolerance the yield varies every capacitor within. Blank takes the component series' tolerance, with a floor of ±0.1 pF below 10 pF.

indTolerance.x-tooltip: Purchase tolerance the yield varies every inductor within. Blank takes the component series' tolerance, with a floor of ±0.2 nH below 10 nH.

yieldTrials.x-tooltip: Builds to simulate with every part drawn within its tolerance; the result reports the share whose worst in-band return loss meets the target. Blank runs no yield. Free tier: max 1,000. Pro and API: up to 100,000.

randomSeed.x-tooltip: Blank derives the seed from the parameters, so the same job repeats exactly. Set it to draw a different sample of the same design.

targetRL.x-tooltip: Return loss the synthesiser aims for across the band; a negative number of dB.

sourceFileRole.x-tooltip: What an uploaded .s2p describes. Ignored when no file is uploaded.
